l4_steps.name: Screen potential partners against loyalty fit criteria
l4_steps.input: Annual partnership strategy, competitor loyalty benchmarking data
l4_steps.output: Qualified partner longlist with fit-score ranking
l4_steps.kpi: Minimum 20 candidates screened per category (hotel/car/retail) per quarter
l4_steps.pain_point: Retail and hotel categories have inconsistent earn-per-dollar standards across IATA-affiliated programmes; benchmarking requires manual OAG and ATPCO data pulls with no automated feed

l4_steps.name: Score partner on member overlap and revenue potential
l4_steps.input: Qualified partner longlist, member travel and spend segmentation data
l4_steps.output: Partner scoring matrix with estimated incremental miles issued
l4_steps.kpi: Projected incremental miles-earned revenue ≥ $500K annually per partner
l4_steps.pain_point: Member spend data outside airline transactions is incomplete; reliance on third-party data append (e.g. Acxiom) adds latency of 4–6 weeks and increases data privacy compliance overhead under GDPR and CCPA

l4_steps.name: Approve partner for commercial engagement
l4_steps.input: Partner scoring matrix, brand alignment assessment
l4_steps.output: Approved partner shortlist; go/no-go decision logged in CRM
l4_steps.kpi: Decision turnaround ≤ 10 business days from submission
l4_steps.pain_point: Approval workflows require sign-off from Legal, Finance, and Brand teams simultaneously; lack of a unified workflow tool causes email-chain approvals that are difficult to audit

l4_steps.name: Define earn/burn mile rates per partner category
l4_steps.input: Approved partner shortlist, ATPCO fare basis data, competitor earn-rate benchmarks
l4_steps.output: Draft earn/burn rate card per partner (miles per $1 spend)
l4_steps.kpi: Earn rate set within ±10% of top-3 competitor benchmark to maintain programme competitiveness
l4_steps.pain_point: Earn rate proposals must account for currency-of-sale variations across hotel booking platforms; multi-currency mile valuation is not natively handled in SAP FI without custom enhancement

l4_steps.name: Model financial liability and breakage assumptions
l4_steps.input: Draft earn/burn rate card, historical redemption rates by tier, actuary breakage estimates
l4_steps.output: Points liability model with 3-year NPV projection and breakage sensitivity analysis
l4_steps.kpi: Projected breakage rate ≥ 20% to ensure programme profitability; liability exposure within approved board ceiling
l4_steps.pain_point: IFRS 15 requires deferred revenue recognition for miles issued; SAP FI configuration for loyalty liability is complex and frequently requires external audit review, delaying deal closure by 2–4 weeks

l4_steps.name: Negotiate SLA terms, data-sharing clauses, and audit rights
l4_steps.input: Approved financial model, partner draft term sheet, GDPR/CCPA data processing requirements
l4_steps.output: Negotiated term sheet with agreed data-sharing protocols and SLA penalties
l4_steps.kpi: Contract execution within 60 days of first commercial engagement; SLA uptime commitment ≥ 99.5% for transaction API
l4_steps.pain_point: Hotel and car rental partners often resist audit rights on transaction data, creating reconciliation disputes; without real-time feeds, monthly batch reconciliations result in miles posting delays of up to 72 hours, breaching member-facing SLA

l4_steps.name: Execute legally signed partnership agreement
l4_steps.input: Final negotiated term sheet, Legal sign-off, Finance approval
l4_steps.output: Countersigned partnership agreement; CRM opportunity moved to Closed Won
l4_steps.kpi: 100% of executed agreements stored in CRM document vault within 24 hours of signature
l4_steps.pain_point: Wet-signature requirements from some international hotel chains (particularly APAC and MEA regions) extend execution timelines; e-signature platforms (DocuSign) not universally accepted by all partners

l4_steps.name: Configure partner profile in loyalty management system
l4_steps.input: Signed partnership agreement, earn/burn rate card, partner branding assets
l4_steps.output: Partner configuration record active in Comarch Loyalty; earn rules loaded
l4_steps.kpi: Partner configuration completed within 5 business days of contract execution
l4_steps.pain_point: Comarch Loyalty rule engine requires structured XML earn-rule definitions; hotel chains with tiered earn rates (e.g. brand-tier multipliers) require multiple rule variants, increasing configuration time and regression test scope

l4_steps.name: Build and certify partner transaction API connector
l4_steps.input: Partner API specification, Comarch Loyalty webhook endpoints, test credentials
l4_steps.output: Certified REST/SOAP connector deployed in AWS API Gateway; sandbox test suite passing
l4_steps.kpi: API throughput ≥ 500 transactions per second; p99 latency ≤ 2 seconds
l4_steps.pain_point: Car rental partners (e.g. Hertz, Enterprise) still expose legacy SOAP APIs; bridging SOAP-to-REST within AWS API Gateway adds development cycles and creates brittle transformation layers that break on partner schema updates

l4_steps.name: Execute UAT — earn/burn transaction end-to-end test
l4_steps.input: Sandbox API connector, test member profiles in Amadeus Altéa PSS, earn/burn rule set
l4_steps.output: UAT test report; pass/fail matrix by transaction scenario
l4_steps.kpi: Transaction error rate < 0.5%; all earn/burn scenarios in test matrix pass before production release
l4_steps.pain_point: Member account linking between Amadeus Altéa PSS and partner booking engines relies on loyalty number matching; mismatched account formats (numeric vs alphanumeric) cause silent earn failures that are only detected in post-flight reconciliation

l4_steps.name: Enable partner earn/burn in production environment
l4_steps.input: UAT sign-off, change advisory board approval, production deployment runbook
l4_steps.output: Partner live in Comarch Loyalty production; transaction monitoring alerts configured in AWS CloudWatch
l4_steps.kpi: Zero P1 incidents in first 72 hours post-launch; real-time alert threshold set at error rate > 1%
l4_steps.pain_point: Production rollbacks are disruptive if a partner API sends unexpected payloads post-launch; Comarch Loyalty does not support canary releases natively, requiring full cutover with no gradual traffic ramp

l4_steps.name: Publish partner to member-facing loyalty portal and app
l4_steps.input: Partner configuration confirmed live, partner logos and copy approved by Brand
l4_steps.output: Partner listing visible on loyalty website earn-partners page and mobile app
l4_steps.kpi: Partner page live within 3 business days of production enablement; page load time ≤ 2 seconds
l4_steps.pain_point: Loyalty portal content management is tightly coupled to Altéa PSS member-facing APIs; content updates require IT release cycle (bi-weekly) rather than CMS self-service, slowing time-to-market for partner promotions

l4_steps.name: Launch targeted co-marketing campaign to member segments
l4_steps.input: Member segments from AWS Redshift, partner co-marketing budget, email/push templates
l4_steps.output: Email and push notification campaign deployed; UTM-tagged campaign links active
l4_steps.kpi: Email open rate ≥ 22%; click-through rate (CTR) ≥ 2%; campaign ROI ≥ 3:1 on miles-issued cost
l4_steps.pain_point: Member communication frequency caps (set in Salesforce Marketing Cloud) limit partnership launch campaigns to one email per member per week; competing loyalty promotions from the same period suppress campaign visibility

l4_steps.name: Monitor partner transaction volumes and error rates weekly
l4_steps.input: AWS CloudWatch API metrics, Comarch Loyalty transaction logs, partner reconciliation files
l4_steps.output: Weekly partner performance dashboard; anomaly alerts escalated to partner account manager
l4_steps.kpi: Transaction volume within ±15% of forecast; earn posting success rate ≥ 99.5%
l4_steps.pain_point: Hotel partners send batch transaction files (nightly SFTP) rather than real-time API calls; delayed posting means members do not see miles for 24–72 hours, generating inbound contact centre volume and NPS drag

l4_steps.name: Audit points liability exposure and breakage monthly
l4_steps.input: Comarch Loyalty issued-miles ledger, SAP deferred revenue balance, redemption actuals
l4_steps.output: Monthly liability reconciliation report; variance flagged for CFO review if > 5% vs forecast
l4_steps.kpi: Liability reconciliation completed by business day 5 of each month; breakage rate maintained ≥ 18%
l4_steps.pain_point: IFRS 15 standalone selling price (SSP) for miles must be updated quarterly; SAP CO-PA margin reporting does not natively integrate with Comarch Loyalty ledger, requiring manual extract-transform-load (ETL) via AWS Redshift

l4_steps.name: Trigger partner performance improvement plan if KPIs missed
l4_steps.input: Weekly performance dashboard, partner SLA breach log, financial variance report
l4_steps.output: Formal performance improvement plan (PIP) issued to partner; 90-day remediation timeline logged in CRM
l4_steps.kpi: PIP issued within 10 business days of confirmed SLA breach; partner response received within 5 business days
l4_steps.pain_point: SLA penalty clauses are often commercially difficult to enforce with major hotel chains (Marriott, Hilton) due to contractual carve-outs; legal escalation stalls programme improvements and damages long-term relationship

l4_steps.name: Conduct annual partner business review (ABR)
l4_steps.input: Full-year transaction data, financial P&L by partner, member satisfaction scores (NPS by earn category)
l4_steps.output: ABR presentation deck; renewal recommendation with commercial term changes proposed
l4_steps.kpi: ABR completed ≥ 90 days before contract expiry; partner NPS score ≥ +30 for renewal consideration
l4_steps.pain_point: Attribution of loyalty revenue uplift to specific partners is difficult; multi-partner journeys (hotel + car + flight) where miles are earned across a trip create ambiguous incrementality data that weakens negotiation positions

l4_steps.name: Execute contract renewal, renegotiation, or off-boarding
l4_steps.input: ABR recommendation, partner counter-proposal, updated financial model from SAP
l4_steps.output: Renewed/amended contract executed; or off-boarding runbook triggered with Comarch Loyalty deactivation schedule
l4_steps.kpi: Contract renewal signed ≥ 30 days before expiry; off-boarding completed within 45 days with zero orphaned earn transactions
l4_steps.pain_point: Partner off-boarding requires coordinated deactivation across Comarch Loyalty, AWS API Gateway, Salesforce Marketing Cloud suppression lists, and Altéa PSS member portal; no single orchestration tool manages the full off-boarding workflow, creating risk of earn transactions processed after contract end
